newsitem.title: USA: New York Bagel gets $10 mln credit pact.
newsitem.headline: New York Bagel gets $10 mln credit pact.

text.p: New York Bagel Enterprises Inc said Friday it entered into a commitment with NationsBank NA concerning a $10.0 million credit facility.

The new $10.0 million credit facility will provide funding for New York Bagel's various corporate activities, including real estate and equipment financing for new and existing restaurants, acquisitions and short term working capital needs.
The credit facility will be secured by substantially all of the assets of New York Bagel.
The company owns and franchises New York Bagel restaurants and owns Lots A' Bagels restaurants.
